title: Use only the authoritative harness names and UPPERCASE codes

facts.note: Task text mentions a harness, a harness code or an acceptance/URN that carries one.
Signal only, not a gate: any artifact kind that may carry a harness name or code.

values: harness name or code written, chosen or changed
acceptance URN harness segment written or changed
facts.note: Needs a diff-level observer that extracts harness names/codes from changed artifacts.

values: read or interpret a harness name/code
map a harness name to its code or typical layers
facts.note: Interpreting an existing (unchanged) harness reference, e.g. when implementing a planned acceptance, is not visible in a diff.
Whether the harness fits the layer under test is a judgement against the typical-layer catalog.

fires: An acceptance or criterion is authored and its harness declared.
An acceptance URN embedding a harness code is written, generated or edited.
A harness is chosen for a criterion targeting a given layer.
An already-planned acceptance is implemented and its harness name/code must be interpreted or mapped to its code.
Docs or reviews name or explain a harness or harness code.
doesNotFire: Work that neither names, chooses, reads nor maps any harness name or harness code.

given: Any acceptance, criterion, URN, test or doc that names a harness or harness code.
when: A harness name or code is written, chosen, generated, read or mapped.
then: Use a harness name from the authoritative vocabulary and exactly its UPPERCASE code from the code map.
prefer: Valid names: unit, http, event, ws, e2e, a11y, visual, metric, job, db, sec, load, script, widget, golden, bloc, integration, rls, edge_function, realtime, storage, smoke. Code = name in UPPERCASE, except visual->VIS, edge_function->EDGE.

Pick a harness whose typical layers include the layer under test: domain: unit; application: unit, http, event, metric, job, sec, script, golden, bloc; integration: http, event, ws, metric, db, sec, load, integration, rls, edge_function, realtime, storage; presentation: e2e, a11y, visual, widget, golden. smoke has no layer entry.
avoid: Invented names or codes, lowercase or variant codes (VISUAL, EDGE_FUNCTION).
A harness whose typical layers exclude the tested layer, without justification.
why: The vocabulary is authoritative: URNs embed the UPPERCASE code and criteria templates share the harness set, so non-canonical names/codes break URN generation and harness lookup.
evidence: Every harness name in the affected artifacts is a key of the code map.
Every harness code in acceptance URNs equals the mapped UPPERCASE code exactly.
Reviewer confirms the chosen harness's typical layers include the target layer.
verifier_detail: Code map (harness_code term, label 'Harness code map', authoritative name -> UPPERCASE code): unit->UNIT, http->HTTP, event->EVENT, ws->WS, e2e->E2E, a11y->A11Y, visual->VIS, metric->METRIC, job->JOB, db->DB, sec->SEC, load->LOAD, script->SCRIPT, widget->WIDGET, golden->GOLDEN, bloc->BLOC, integration->INTEGRATION, rls->RLS, edge_function->EDGE, realtime->REALTIME, storage->STORAGE, smoke->SMOKE.
Non-identity mappings to check exactly: visual->VIS, edge_function->EDGE. Codes are case-sensitive UPPERCASE.

Typical-layer catalog (harness_type term, label 'Harness type catalog', 'per-harness description and typical layers'): unit [domain, application]; http [integration, application]; event [application, integration]; ws [integration]; e2e [presentation]; a11y [presentation]; visual [presentation]; metric [application, integration]; job [application]; db [integration]; sec [application, integration]; load [integration]; script [application]; widget [presentation]; golden [presentation, application]; bloc [application]; integration [integration]; rls [integration]; edge_function [integration]; realtime [integration]; storage [integration].

smoke has a code (SMOKE) but no typical-layer catalog entry; do not flag smoke for layer mismatch. The catalog values carry only layers; no per-harness description text is present in the source despite the label.

additions.text: The source is a vocabulary family with two terms: code map (primary obligation in then) and typical-layer catalog (kept as prefer[1]/avoid[1]); a separate planner.acceptance.harness-layer-fit convention could own the catalog.
Avoid choosing a harness whose typical layers exclude the tested layer without justification.
additions.justification: Operationalises the source's 'typical layers' catalog as a decision; 'typical' implies guidance, not a hard ban.

additions.text: Reason references URN embedding and shared harness set with criteria templates.
additions.justification: Source has no why; derived from graph.json edges (urn-generation, harness-templates).

additions.text: Activation is phrased as any writing, choosing, generating, reading or mapping of a harness name/code, with no actor, path or artifact-kind gate (file_kind is a signal only).
additions.justification: The source defines an authoritative vocabulary without actor/location/change-only restrictions; activation mirrors that breadth. Wording targets the planner audience but does not exclude other readers.

additions.text: Code map is stated compactly as 'name in UPPERCASE except visual->VIS, edge_function->EDGE' and the catalog is regrouped by layer; the full per-harness forms stay in verifier_detail[0] and [2].
additions.justification: Keeps coder-facing text near the size budget while preserving every mapping losslessly.
